prompt: Read-only Android UI inspection. Using ~/bin/rish, capture the current foreground UI hierarchy with uiautomator dump to a temporary file under /sdcard, read it, then remove only that temporary file. Do not tap, type, launch, navigate, or change any app/system state. Report: current foreground package if visible, visible text labels, clickable controls with their bounds, editable fields, and any accessibility content descriptions. Keep the report concise and do not include unrelated hidden/off-screen nodes.
